language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi there, my name is Frederik. This is the shrimp boat we’re using for our trip around the North Sea. My dog Max loves to sail and bark at the seagulls.
I’m doing a lot of experiments about light to find out how it helps people to see things.

I love to learn about light. Light is a form of energy and comes from sources like the sun, fire and electricity. We can see things when light bounces off from things into our eyes. Therefore, when it’s dark we cannot see, as there is no light to reach our eyes.
On our boat, we like to do experiments using the equipment we keep on the deck. Let’s start an experiment now.

Light can come from natural sources, from man-made objects and from living things. Without light, it is dark, and in the dark, we can not see things. Now, I have lost my dog Max. He is hiding somewhere. Please choose a source of light so I can find him.
